Setup.title: Setup check
Setup.intro: Checks that your platform is configured correctly. Fix anything red; yellow items are recommendations.
Setup.summaryFail: {count, plural, one {# problem needs} other {# problems need}} fixing.
Setup.manual: Not checked automatically: in Supabase → Authentication → URL Configuration, the Site URL must be your site's address, and the email templates must be the ones from the README.

env.title: Environment variables
env.fix: Add the missing variables in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables, then redeploy.

database.title: Database
database.fix: Run supabase/setup.sql in the Supabase SQL editor (new projects), or the new migrations (updates). See docs/UPGRADING.md.

storage.title: File storage (logo and QR code)
storage.fix: The "branding" storage bucket is missing. Run supabase/setup.sql.

admins.title: At least one admin
admins.fix: Put your email in ADMIN_EMAILS and log in.

logo.title: Logo uploaded
logo.fix: Upload a logo under Admin → Settings.

payment.title: Payment details
payment.fix: You charge a membership fee, so add how to pay under Admin → Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy policy reviewed
privacy.fix: Review the default privacy policy and publish your own version under Admin → Settings → Privacy policy.

smtp.title: Email sending (SMTP)
smtp.fix: Check SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS and SMTP_FROM. They must match your email provider.

siteUrl.title: Site URL
siteUrl.fix: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL should be the address you're visiting now. Update it in Vercel, and the Site URL in Supabase.

cron.title: Daily job (event reminders)
cron.fix: Set CRON_SECRET in Vercel so reminders are sent and your free Supabase project stays active.
